verses: I also saw the soul of a woman who ever dug into a hill with her own breasts; and ever held, on her head, a mill-stone like a cap.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffered so severe a punishment?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked woman who, in the world, destroyed her own infant, and threw away the corpse.'
